title: Tecate Emblema Festival Opens at Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez
detail: The two-day Tecate Emblema Festival opened on May 16 at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez in Iztacalco, featuring international headliners Jonas Brothers, Louis Tomlinson, and Argentine rapper Cazzu on the first day, with additional acts across multiple stages. The festival is one of Mexico City's largest annual events and a major economic driver for the hospitality, transport, and retail sectors in the eastern city corridor. SEMOVI and STC Metro activated enhanced service on Lines 3, 9, and B serving the Autódromo, alongside traffic management protocols on the Circuito Interior. The event concludes a landmark week for CDMX events tourism, following the BTS Arirang World Tour three-night run at Estadio GNP (May 7–10). With the FIFA World Cup opening match scheduled at Estadio Azteca on June 11, CDMX will host back-to-back mega-events through June 2026.
